title: Microsoft Outlook Elevation of Privilege via NTLM Leak (CVE-2023-23397)
text: CVE-2023-23397 is an elevation of privilege vulnerability in Microsoft Outlook for Windows. An attacker sends an email containing an extended MAPI reminder property that points to a UNC path on an attacker-controlled server. When Outlook processes the reminder, it automatically authenticates to that path, leaking the victim's Net-NTLMv2 hash with no user interaction and before the email is even opened. This is forced authentication; the leaked hash can be relayed or cracked. The CVSS base score is 9.8 (Critical). Apply the update, block outbound SMB (TCP 445) to the internet, and consider adding high-value users to the Protected Users group to prevent NTLM authentication.
